previous_statement: The right side in 1.4.2 equals N + n(w_k), because N=sum_i p_i n(w_i), the quantity n(w_k) is independent of i, and sum_i p_i=1.
new_statement: Using the local abbreviation introduced in 1.1, N = sum_i p_i n(w_i); hence the right side in 1.4.2 equals N + n(w_k), because the first summand is N, the quantity n(w_k) is independent of i, and sum_i p_i=1.
